title: Agent Definition
description: JSON Schema describing the parsed form of an agent file with frontmatter prompt and rules

$schema.description: Optional relative path to this schema so editors can validate the file

name.description: Agent name of two kebab tokens where the second token ends in er

description.description: One short sentence saying when to use the agent not just what it does

model.description: The model tier this agent runs on

skills.description: Skills the agent relies on with at least one entry

items.description: A skill name of two kebab tokens

prompt.description: Opening line stating the role and the process this agent follows

rules.description: List of DIW rules in which no item is a near duplicate of another

checklists.description: List of checklist items each with an action a done condition and a skip condition

action.description: The action to perform as one short sentence ending with a period

done_when.description: The condition that marks the action complete

skip_when.description: The condition under which the action can be skipped
